CustomField.formula: IF(OR( AND(UPPER(TRIM(Promo_Code__c)) = "OE", ISBLANK(TEXT(License_Model_Override__c))), TEXT(License_Model__c) = "Firmwide License", AND(TEXT(License_Model__c) = "Authorised Users", ISBLANK(TEXT(License_Model_Override__c)), Authorised_User_Count__c = 1, TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Family) = "Subs - Lexology Pro", IF(SBQQ__ProratedListPrice__c > 0, SBQQ__ProratedListPrice__c, SBQQ__ListPrice__c) > 0, SBQQ__NetTotal__c >= 2 * IF(SBQQ__ProratedListPrice__c > 0, SBQQ__ProratedListPrice__c, SBQQ__ListPrice__c)) ), "Firmwide License", CASE(TEXT(License_Model__c), "Limited Access", IF(Authorised_User_Count__c > 0, "Limited Access - up to " & TEXT(Authorised_User_Count__c) & IF(Authorised_User_Count__c = 1, " user", " users"), "Limited Access"), "Authorised Users", IF(Authorised_User_Count__c > 0, TEXT(Authorised_User_Count__c) & IF(Authorised_User_Count__c = 1, " named user", " named users"), "Authorised Users"), "Benefiting Group", "Benefiting Group", "Included", "Included", "Enterprise-Wide Access", "Enterprise-Wide Access", TEXT(License_Model__c)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Short licence label for the Order Form products table; the full contractual sentence prints once per product in the Licence terms section.
CustomField.label: License Model (Short)
